cues: Appearance and reality: the truth sits behind a curtain the whole time.
Persuasion over proof: the wife has real evidence, and a good story beats it.
Acting off the stage: the actress performs even when no curtain has risen.
And irony: the wronged wife leaves happier than she arrived, and more deceived.
